principles: Social-media PnL claims are unverified unless independently corroborated.
Affiliate/referral-heavy posts are treated as idea sources, not performance evidence.
Only causal/as-of, cost-aware, falsifiable hypotheses may flow into Superman research.
No production/live/real-money change is authorized by this batch.

themes.takeaway: Continuously rank symbols and allow re-entry/rotation without attachment to the prior position, but rotate only when the new expected net edge exceeds switching costs plus a safety margin.
themes.caution: Extreme $50->$3,532 claim is not independently verified.

themes.takeaway: For existing SHORT candidates, test favorable funding carry only together with supportive downside momentum and adequate depth/spread. Funding alone must never create a short.
themes.caution: Claimed $43->$5,843 and 85% win rate are unverified.

themes.takeaway: Reject low-depth/high-spread or structurally unsafe candidates before entry; a veto layer can be more valuable than adding more entry signals.
themes.caution: Many examples are memecoin/spot-specific and include promotional links, so only the generic liquidity/risk principle transfers to futures.

themes.takeaway: Track provenance-scored wallets, clustered entries, holding times and exits; require multiple independent wallets and point-in-time data. Avoid simple copy-trading.
themes.verified_external_context: Bitquery documents a read-only MCP with DEX trades, transfers, wallet history, labels and near-real-time data; free tier exists but is metered.
themes.caution: Wallet PnL and no-loss claims in the posts are unverified and highly exposed to survivorship/manipulation bias.

themes.takeaway: Research BTC short-horizon Polymarket order-book lead/lag versus spot/futures, EMA/RSI as simple baselines, and mispricing/arbitrage only with realistic latency, fill probability and fees.
themes.verified_external_context: Open-source Polymarket historical dataset and backtesting frameworks exist.
themes.caution: Claims of zero-loss wallets, 100ms arbitrage and huge PnL are not verified.

themes.takeaway: Separate scanner, thesis, sizing, execution and veto/risk roles. Superman already follows much of this separation through Guardian/R&D/shadow gates.
themes.verified_external_context: Alook is a real Apache-2.0 open-source local-first agent collaboration project.
